title: Recovery of [1][waqf] property transferred in contravention of section 51
text:
52. Recovery of [waqf] property transferred in contravention of section 51.—(1) If the Board is

satisfied, after making any inquiry in such manner as may be prescribed, that any immovable property of
a [waqf] entered as such in the register of [[waqf] maintained under section 36, has been transferred](http://www.tnwakfboard.org/1995.43.htm#s36)
[without the previous sanction of the Board in contravention of the provisions of section 51](http://www.tnwakfboard.org/1995.43.htm#s51) [or section
56], it may send a requisition to the Collector within whose jurisdiction the property is situate to obtain
and deliver possession of the property to it.
